description: Knowledge about the human body, health, diseases, prevention, treatments, and medical science.

topics.name: Medical Fundamentals
knowledge: Medicine is the science of preventing, diagnosing, and treating health conditions.
Healthcare combines biology, chemistry, technology, and clinical knowledge.
The human body is made of interconnected systems that work together.

topics.name: Human Body
knowledge: The human body contains systems such as the nervous, circulatory, respiratory, digestive, and immune systems.
Organs perform specialized functions necessary for life.
Cells are the basic structural and functional units of the body.

topics.name: Health and Prevention
knowledge: Preventive healthcare focuses on reducing disease risks before problems occur.
Healthy habits include balanced nutrition, physical activity, sleep, and hygiene.
Regular medical checkups help detect some health problems early.

topics.name: Diseases and Conditions
knowledge: Diseases can be caused by infections, genetics, environmental factors, or changes in body function.
Doctors diagnose conditions using symptoms, examinations, tests, and medical knowledge.
Treatment depends on the specific condition and individual needs.

topics.name: Medical Technology
knowledge: Medical technology helps diagnose, monitor, and treat health conditions.
Imaging technologies allow doctors to view structures inside the body.
Artificial intelligence can assist healthcare professionals with data analysis and research.

topics.name: Human Biology
knowledge: DNA carries genetic information that influences biological characteristics.
The immune system protects the body from harmful organisms.
The brain controls many functions including movement, learning, and communication.

topics.name: Healthcare Ethics
knowledge: Medical decisions should respect safety, privacy, and human dignity.
Healthcare professionals follow ethical principles when caring for patients.
Medical information should be handled responsibly.
